Du löst ein Single-Item Lot-Sizing-Problem mit Kapazitätsrestriktion über 25 Perioden. In jeder Periode kann produziert werden (mit fixen Setup-Kosten, falls produziert wird, plus variablen Produktionskosten pro Einheit), bis zur jeweiligen Kapazitätsgrenze. Ziel: Minimiere die Gesamtkosten (Setup + Produktion + Lagerhaltung) über alle Perioden, sodass die Nachfrage jeder Periode exakt gedeckt wird.

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 261, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "2": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 148, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "3": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 133, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},

    "10": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 278, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "11": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 296, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "12": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 202, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "13": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 169, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "14": {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 262, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "15": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 135, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "16": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 487, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "17": {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 244, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "18": {"demand": 38, "setup_cost": 322, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "19": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 388, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "20": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 477, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "21": {"demand": 32, "setup_cost": 410, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "22": {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 137, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "23": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 100, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "24": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 350, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "25": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 483, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 67, "2": 23, "3": 29, "4": 52, "5": 49, "6": 14, "7": 43, "8": 33,
    "9": 13, "10": 41, "11": 41, "12": 49, "13": 12, "14": 33, "15": 8, "16": 30,
    "17": 25, "18": 33, "19": 37, "20": 24, "21": 37, "22": 27, "23": 20, "24": 27, "25": 64
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
periods = list(period_data.keys())
production = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere Gesamtkosten
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[p]["setup_cost"] * setup[p] +
        period_data[p]["prod_cost"] * production[p] +
        period_data[p]["holding_cost"] * inventory[p]
        for p in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for i, p in enumerate(periods):
    # Nachfragebedingung
    if i == 0:
        model.addConstr(production[p] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[p] + inventory[periods[i-1]] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    
    # Kapazitätsbedingung
    model.addConstr(production[p] <= capacity[p] * setup[p])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[p] >= 0)

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Ausgabe der Ergebnisse
result = {
    "production": {p: production[p].X for p in periods},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

import json
print(json.dumps(result))
